segments.ja486:1.1: Ukkā cilācā [milācā (sī. syā. pī.)] bandhanti dīpe [bandhanti luddā, dīpe (ka.)], pajā mamaṃ khādituṃ patthayanti;
segments.ja486:1.3: Mittaṃ sahāyañca vadehi senaka, ācikkha ñātibyasanaṃ dijānaṃ.
segments.ja486:2.1: Dijo dijānaṃ pavarosi pakkhima [pakkhi (sī. pī.), pakkhi ca (syā.)], ukkusarāja saraṇaṃ taṃ upema [upemi (sī. syā. pī.)];
segments.ja486:2.3: Pajā mamaṃ khādituṃ patthayanti, luddā cilācā [milācā (sī. syā. pī.)] bhava me sukhāya.
segments.ja486:3.1: Mittaṃ sahāyañca karonti paṇḍitā, kāle akāle sukhamesamānā [māsayānā (pī.)];
segments.ja486:3.3: Karomi te senaka etamatthaṃ, ariyo hi ariyassa karoti kiccaṃ.
segments.ja486:4.1: Yaṃ hoti kiccaṃ anukampakena, ariyassa ariyena kataṃ tayīdaṃ [tava yidaṃ (sī. pī.)];
segments.ja486:4.3: Attānurakkhī bhava mā adayhi [aḍayha (sī. pī.)], lacchāma putte tayi jīvamāne.
segments.ja486:5.1: Taveva [tameva (syā. ka.)] rakkhāvaraṇaṃ karonto, sarīrabhedāpi na santasāmi;
segments.ja486:5.3: Karonti heke [hete (ka. sī. syā. pī.)] sakhīnaṃ sakhāro, pāṇaṃ cajantā [cajanti (sī. pī.)] satamesa [satānesa (pī.)] dhammo.
segments.ja486:7.1: Cutāpi heke [eke (sī. pī.)] khalitā sakammunā, mittānukampāya patiṭṭhahanti;
segments.ja486:7.3: Puttā mamaṭṭā gatimāgatosmi, atthaṃ caretho [caretha (sī. syā. pī.)] mama vāricara [vārichanna (sī. pī.)].
segments.ja486:8.1: Dhanena dhaññena ca attanā ca, mittaṃ sahāyañca karonti paṇḍitā;
segments.ja486:8.3: Karomi te senaka etamatthaṃ, ariyo hi ariyassa karoti kiccaṃ.
segments.ja486:9.1: Appossukko tāta tuvaṃ nisīda, putto pitu carati atthacariyaṃ;
segments.ja486:9.3: Ahaṃ carissāmi tavetamatthaṃ, senassa putte paritāyamāno.
segments.ja486:10.1: Addhā hi tāta satamesa dhammo, putto pitu yaṃ care [pitunaṃ care (ka.), pitu yañcaretha (sī. pī.)] atthacariyaṃ;
segments.ja486:10.3: Appeva maṃ disvāna pavaḍḍhakāyaṃ, senassa puttā na viheṭhayeyyuṃ.
segments.ja486:11.1: Pasū manussā migavīraseṭṭha [migaviriyaseṭṭha (sī. pī.)], bhayaṭṭitā [bhayadditā (sī. pī.)] seṭṭhamupabbajanti;
segments.ja486:11.3: Puttā mamaṭṭā gatimāgatosmi, tvaṃ nosi rājā bhava me sukhāya.
segments.ja486:12.1: Karomi te senaka etamatthaṃ, āyāmi te taṃ disataṃ vadhāya;
segments.ja486:12.3: Kathañhi viññū pahu sampajāno, na vāyame attajanassa guttiyā.
segments.ja486:13.1: Mittañca kayirātha suhadayañca [suhaddayañca (sī.), sakhāgharañca (pī.)], ayirañca kayirātha sukhāgamāya;
segments.ja486:13.3: Nivatthakocova [kojova (sī. pī.)] sarebhihantvā, modāma puttehi samaṅgibhūtā.
segments.ja486:15.1: Mittaṃ sahāyaṃ adhigamma paṇḍito, so bhuñjatī putta pasuṃ dhanaṃ vā;
segments.ja486:15.3: Ahañca puttā ca patī ca mayhaṃ, mittānukampāya samaṅgibhūtā.
segments.ja486:16.1: Rājavatā sūravatā ca attho, sampannasakhissa bhavanti hete;
segments.ja486:16.3: So mittavā yasavā uggatatto, asmiṃdhaloke [asmiñca loke (sī. syā. pī.)] modati kāmakāmī.
segments.ja486:18.1: Sūrena balavantena, yo mitte [mette (sī.), mittaṃ (syā.)] kurute dijo;
segments.ja486:18.3: Evaṃ so sukhito hoti, yathāhaṃ tvañca senakāti.
